state.verified_context: Repository 99a53f93d2e3cccd392a6f328b5347e7d96b3128. CanFeedback.can has public Suggestion fields title/description/category/status/response only while Product.published and not Suggestion.hidden; authors and responsible product owners have private access. New submissions are hidden, contributor edits hide them and clear moderation_reason, and explicit owner moderation can unhide. roadmap may update status/response/duplicate even while hidden. Anonymous public reports expose current approved cards and counts, never voter identities. Generic history filters by CURRENT field grants, not historical approval, so exposing it could reveal rejected revisions. Current Decision history is author/owner only. Requirements ask for a public operator-decision history and an in-page Product picker. Existing published-decision facts are not yet modeled. DESIGN supports private owned child models, immutable field locks, atomic scenario writes, nullable model references, authority reads returning closed structural projections, viewer-scoped derives and array UI collections with typed reference filters and preference defaults. There is no implemented compiler/runtime. An explicit staff publication must be distinguishable from a private hidden draft. Withdrawal must remove an unsafe previously approved response from public history without erasing private evidence. Product unpublication, suggestion hiding and archival must deny current public history requests; exported copies cannot be recalled.
state.history_options: A: Add private Decision child snapshots (status,response,published_at nullable,withdrawn flag,private withdrawal reason) and Suggestion.current_decision reference. roadmap always appends a locked snapshot and updates current state; it sets published_at=now only if not hidden. While hidden, earlier decision drafts remain unreleased; moderate(false) releases only current_decision if not withdrawn/unreleased. Already approved decisions survive later contributor edits but disappear while suggestion hidden; only explicit republication restores approved history. Product.published gates disclosure; decisions recorded on an approved suggestion in an unpublished Product are intentionally ready for later product publication. An owner can irreversibly withdraw any snapshot; if current, the same atomic operation hides Suggestion, clears current_decision/response/duplicate and resets status to proposed. A dedicated public authority read checks active/published/unhidden ancestors and returns only status,response,published_at for released nonwithdrawn snapshots, never model IDs/authors/moderation reasons or contributor text. B: Keep approved decision snapshots only for the current continuous public review epoch, advance epoch on reapproval, and disclose only that epoch. Old decisions stay private forever after hiding/review; fewer withdrawal concerns but planned-to-shipped public continuity can vanish after an innocent title edit. C: Extend generic history with per-revision publication approval/redaction metadata; reuse audit storage and avoid Decision state, but define a new runtime historical-disclosure contract and explicit selective withdrawal.
state.selector_options: A: Add a small nonstored ProductChoice contract (product:Product,name:text,location:Location?) and a viewer-scoped derive returning ordinary authorized Product projections. Render it with existing list rows, filter=product,location, defaults from existing preferences and name search. Explicitly bind existing create/read/update forms to row.product. Remove the old hard preference WHERE so a local clear/change works. No business operation or new UI syntax; this copies two presentation fields and requires normal bounded array/query handling. B: Extend collection filter selectors with a typed self-record filter that targets the Product identity; retain original Product row context and existing child code, but specify a new selector meaning and target metadata shape shared by all apps. Both must recheck current grants and never save an ordinary toolbar change as a preference automatically.

history.instructions: Which bounded design best meets safe public history, retained private evidence, workflow continuity and simple implementable source semantics? Judge tradeoffs, not proof of runtime correctness.

criteria.A: Explicit private Decision snapshots with a current pointer, release time and one-way withdrawal; ordinary typed public projection.
criteria.B: Public history restricted to the current approval epoch; prior approved entries become permanently private when reviewed again.
criteria.C: Add a shared per-revision publication/redaction capability to generic audit history.

selector.instructions: Which Product-picker implementation is the better minimal design for this bounded app handoff, given the existing constructs and the stated costs?

criteria.A: Use a small typed ProductChoice projection and ordinary reference filter/defaults, binding existing operations explicitly.
criteria.B: Introduce a shared self-record filter selector contract and keep original model-row nesting.
